newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: CSA unit gets approval for Malaysia listing.
newsitem.headline: CSA unit gets approval for Malaysia listing.

text.p: CSA Holdings Ltd said on Thursday its Malaysian subsidiary obtained approval to list on the second board of the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.
Computer Systems Advisers (M) Bhd (CSAM) got approval from Suruhanjaya Sekuriti for the listing, it said in a statement.

It said the approval was given on condition that CSAM's substantial shareholders of CSAM guaranteed it would achieve 90 percent of the pre-tax profit forecast for 1997 and 90 percent of the maintainable pre-tax profits for the subsequent two financial years.
The computation of maintainable pre-tax profit is the weighted average profits based on the actual profits for the past three years and forecasts for the next three years.
Upon listing, CSA's interest in CSAM will be reduced to below 50 percent of the enlarged capital of CSAM.
The reduced shareholding will reduce the profit contribution from CSAM from 1997.
But the expected improvement in earnings in CSAM from the listing may offset the dilutory effect on the CSA Group's performance, the statement said.
It said the listing would not have any financial effect on the performance of CSA for the financial year ended December 31.
